summary: Iteration 28: Comprehensive testing of new features - Bottom nav order changes, profile hyperlinks, and NFC PIUP Manager. All backend NFC APIs (12 tests) passed. Frontend features fully functional.
seed_data_creation: Created test NFC tags: TEST-NFC-*, TEST-NFC-CFG-*, TEST-NFC-LOCK-*, TEST-RESOLVE-*
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 tested all new features successfully. NFC PIUP Manager is fully functional with 3 tabs (Mis Tags, Activar Nuevo, Tienda PIUP). Profile hyperlinks work in posts, cards, and chat. Bottom nav order is correct: Home, Live, Create, Map, Notifications(Alertas), Profile.

bottom_nav_order.details: Bottom nav order is: home, lives, create, map, notifications, profile (as expected)

post_profile_links.details: PostCard username click navigates to /profile/{userId}. Found 9 profile links in feed, verified href format

card_profile_links.details: GridCard in FeedPage shows 'Ver perfil del autor' link to /profile/{user_id}. Found 8 links in Explore tab

chat_profile_navigation.details: ChatPage header has profile navigation on avatar/name click via onClick handler

nfc_manager_page.details: NFC Manager page at /nfc/manage loads correctly with 3 tabs

nfc_manager_button_on_profile.details: MyProfilePage has NFC Manager button with CreditCard icon

nfc_activate_tab.details: Activate tab shows NFC ID input, 11 product options, and activate button

nfc_store_tab.details: Store tab shows 11 NFC products with gradients and buy buttons

nfc_api_product_schemas.details: GET /api/nfc/product-schemas returns schemas with correct fields (WiFi has ssid+password, Emergency has blood_type+contacts)

nfc_api_activate.details: POST /api/nfc/activate creates new NFC tag linked to card

nfc_api_resolve_product.details: GET /api/nfc/resolve-product/{nfc_id} returns product info and checks lock
